Write a short-form video script for this piece of content
I used to lose an hour every morning to the same five tasks.
Then I gave them to five small tools, and I got the hour back.
First: a calendar that books calls for me.
Second: a notes app that turns voice memos into to-do lists.
Third: an inbox filter that answers the easy questions.
Fourth: a template for every proposal I send.
Fifth: a weekly review that takes ten minutes, not sixty.
Pick one today. Next week, pick another.
Follow for the setup of each one.
